'''Jamila''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Jamila ran a repair shop in [[Filly]]. She has a vocal box [[Cybernetic organism|implant]] grafted into her cheek.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Head]]===
[[File:FOTV s1 ep3 Jamila haggles.png|thumb|250px|left]]

[[Maximus]] approaches Jamila's repair shop to repair a device for his [[T-60 power armor (TV series)|T-60 power armor]] suit. After examining it, Jamila claims she can repair it for five [[Bottle cap|caps]], but Maximus, who was short a cap, tries to haggle, but Jamila refuses.

So, Maximus visits a [[Dentist-barber|dentist]], where he sells one of his teeth to earn the necessary caps to have his device fixed by Jamila. When Maximus offers her an extra cap if she does it fast, Jamila takes the device, quickly cauterizes it, and thanks him for his service.

==Appearances==
Jamila appears only {{in|FOTV}}.

They are apparently [[cannibalism|cannibals]] who try to fool their victims by pretending to be unarmed and then attacking when they get near. He carries [[Javin's revolver|a revolver]] that uses rotten teeth as ammunition. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Past]]=== Javin and [[Rink]] meet [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[Maximus]] at the opposite end of a railway bridge while the latter two are near the ruins of [[Shady Sands]], tracking [[Thaddeus]]. They initially pretend to be cautious travelers, calling out to Lucy and Maximus and asking whether or not they are armed. Lucy does not think anything more of it, but Maximus is correctly suspicious, seeing that Javin and Rink are hiding their own weapons. Maximus offers to stay there and let them pass the bridge first, but Javin claims that this is a trap.
